_comment: Expectations for the RASP (runtime self-observation) checks. These are the
values API-ON-DROPLET.md records as deployed; the checks compare the LIVE box
against them and name the property that drifted.
This file holds expectations only. Observed run-to-run state (the last
NRestarts, the canary timings) is written to rasp-runtime-state.json next to
it, so a nightly run never rewrites the thing it is grading itself against.

env._source: lib/tuning.ts — the floors below are the ones whose zero hangs or disarms the service
env._note: Only these numeric knobs are read off the box. Secret-valued variables are reported as present/absent and by length, never by value.

requiredSecrets.name: ALTCHA_HMAC_KEY
requiredSecrets.why: lib/altcha.ts:76-81 throws without it and /challenge becomes a 503 for everyone

requiredSecrets.name: REDIS_URL
requiredSecrets.why: its absence silently disables PoW single-use, the shared rate limiter and /event counting

canary._source: scripts/deploy-api.sh:102-105 — the same three paths, checked nightly instead of only at deploy time
canary._medianNote: Seeded 2026-09-19 from three healthy runs against the live box (all 200). WordPress at / is the variable one (451/915ms), the two static trees are steady at ~350/~300ms. Re-seed from rasp-runtime-state.json if the box or its content changes shape.

apache._probePathNote: relative to ctx.apiBase, which is already <origin>/api
